Welcome to the RaukR 2026 cohort! Each card below is **one `.qmd` file** added by a
student. Adding yourself here is the easiest, conflict-free way to get your first
pull request merged. 🎉

::: {.callout-note}
## How to add yourself
1. Copy one of the example files in the `people/` folder (e.g. `example-maria.qmd`).
2. Rename it to your own name, e.g. `people/your-name.qmd`.
3. Fill in your details and open a pull request.

Because you're adding a **brand-new file**, this almost never causes a merge conflict —
the gallery below is generated automatically. ✨
:::
